evidence: Evidence from November 18 shows the cryptocurrency market struggling in the wake of the severe mid-November sell-off triggered by the Bitcoin Cash hash war. While BTC experienced a modest consolidation and relief bounce toward $5,500–$5,600, multiple technical analyses and market reports emphasize strong overhead resistance ($5,550 to $5,620) and expect bearish pressure to resume. Bullish fundamental developments, such as the approval of the Amun Swiss crypto ETP, offer minor long-term sentiment support but are outweighed in the 24-hour horizon by fragile technical structure and widespread expectation of renewed selling into any rallies.
limitations: Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
